page.layout: One column of text. A continuation paragraph at the top, then a centred heading, then verse set as stanzas. A catchword at the lower right. No margin notes.

main_text.p: & efficiat, ut Ionæ exemplo admoniti, diligenter nostro munere fungamur, nec unquam de ἀποταξίᾳ[?] cogitemus, Deiq; consilio per omnem vitam seruiamus. Amen. Anno Domini 1581. mense Iulio, Sit nomè Domini benedictum in seculà.
main_text.head: PSALMVS CIII, REDA-ctus in Carmen Heroicum.
main_text.p: Mens mea, prompta Deum meritis, age, lau-dibus effer, (m imo[?] Sanctum eius celebret nomè, quæ pectore Sunt fibræ, & toto collectæ è corpore vires.
Mens mea, tolle Deum meritis, age, laudibus, atq; irrita ferre sinas huius benefacta cauęto, Et vacuum celeres dispergere in aera ventos,
Ille tibi scelera & delicta admissa remittit: Ille salutarem membris bonus admonet ægris Sponte manum, ignotaq; fouet mortalibus artę; Ille tuam seruat medio in discrimine vitam:
Ille necem, quoties tibi adest infesta, suisq; Te iamiam telis est confixura, repellit: Ille tuis semper precibus respondet amicę, Teque beat donis variis, rebusque secundis:
Ille tuo angores, & tristes pectore curas Eijcit, ac largum potumq; cibumq; ministrat;

page.notes: The scan is slightly faint at the left edge. Lines in the verse are read as printed, with long s written as s; u/v and i/j are normalised. The stanza division is inferred from the repeated openings ("Mens mea", "Ille") and may not match the printer's exact breaks. "Dtum" in the first line may be a printing error for "Deum" and is left as printed. The Greek word at the top is uncertain and marked [?]. "(m imo" is unclear.
